title: Cow holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M33 32 Q38 42 42 50' fill='none' stroke='#9ee7ff' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='20' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='20' rx='11' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ecb' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <path d='M30 33 L27 36 L33 36 Z' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='15' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffc2dd' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='68' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#f4f4f8'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='68' rx='24' ry='18' fill='none' stroke='#c9c9d6' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#5a5a72'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='73' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#5a5a72'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='42' y='82' width='5' height='11' rx='2' fill='#e3e3ec'/>
  <rect x='52' y='83' width='5' height='11' rx='2' fill='#e3e3ec'/>
  <rect x='64' y='83' width='5' height='11' rx='2' fill='#e3e3ec'/>
  <rect x='73' y='82' width='5' height='11' rx='2' fill='#e3e3ec'/>
  <rect x='42' y='91' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a8a9c'/>
  <rect x='52' y='92' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a8a9c'/>
  <rect x='64' y='92' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a8a9c'/>
  <rect x='73' y='91' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a8a9c'/>
  <!-- front leg holding string -->
  <rect x='36' y='70' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e3e3ec' transform='rotate(20 38 76)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='53' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#f4f4f8'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='53' rx='14' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#c9c9d6' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- head spot -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='47' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#5a5a72'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='48' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e3e3ec'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='45' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e3e3ec'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='58' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ffd0d8'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='57' r='1.4' fill='#d97a92'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='57' r='1.4' fill='#d97a92'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='49' r='2.2' fill='#3a3a52'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='48' r='2.2' fill='#3a3a52'/>
  <circle cx='36.7' cy='48.2' r='0.8' fill='#9ee7ff'/>
  <circle cx='45.7' cy='47.2' r='0.8' fill='#9ee7ff'/>
  <!-- horn -->
  <path d='M44 42 Q46 38 49 40' fill='none' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M80 64 Q87 62 86 56' fill='none' stroke='#e3e3ec' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='55' r='2.6' fill='#5a5a72'/>
</svg>
